messages:
Maya (SRE): Quick follow-up from today's postmortem. We need a compact action list for vendor/dependency hardening (cloud provider, model-registry auth). Who owns what + ETA?
Diego: I'll own cloud failover validation and routing policy updates. Proposal: 7-day focused sprint. ETA: 2026-04-07.
Maya (SRE): Please include acceptance: control-plane RTO <60s and no regional 5xx during failover.
Leo (Infra): I'll add post-deploy smoke tests to CI for model-registry and a small auth-flood script: `ci/smoke/auth_flood.sh`. ETA: 2026-03-31.
Oncall Bot: Incident #2026-33456 logged and linked. Recurring mini-drill scheduled monthly (15m).
CloudCo Ops: We'll publish updated escalation contact card and suggested client retry windows by 2026-03-29.
Ava (Platform): I'll own model-registry auth resiliency (jitter + CB + cache fallback). Plan: PR + canary in staging. ETA: 2026-04-05.
Diego: Adding a dashboard for recurrence detection (`vendor_dependency_spike_count`). If >3 spikes in 30d auto-open a retro ticket.
Maya (SRE): Good. Add alerts: `model_registry_auth_error_rate >0.5% for 5m` and `service_5xx_rate >1% for 3m`.
Ava (Platform): PR link will be posted when ready; acceptance: under simulated token storm, auth_error_rate <0.5% and p95 latency delta <10%.
Diego: I'll create the tracker and drop link here by EOD. We keep these in the focused sprint, and run the joint DR with CloudCo during week 2.
Maya (SRE): Thanks. Once tracker is up, owners add PRs, CI links, and test dates. We'll review results one week after sprint end. :thumbsup:
